models.name: Flux.2 [pro]
models.notes: Flagship standard model in the Flux.2 series; supports prompt + reference-image generation/editing. Integrated via Flux2ImageNode (DynamicCombo), priced from ~$0.03/MP. [verified: FLUX.2 family 2025-11-25; FLUX 3 exists (2026-07-23 early access) but FLUX.2 still default for images, sources: bfl.ai/blog]

models.name: Flux.2 [max]
models.notes: High-end Flux.2 tier with higher output quality, from ~$0.07/MP; also supports reference images. [verified: launched 2025-12-16, sources: bfl.ai/blog]

models.name: Flux.1 Kontext [pro]/[max]
models.notes: Instruction-based image editing model (FluxKontextProImageNode / DISPLAY_NAME 'Flux.1 Kontext [pro] Image'). [verified: released 2025-05-29; docs now recommend FLUX.2 for new projects, sources: bfl.ai/blog]

models.name: Flux 1.1 [pro] Ultra
models.notes: FluxProUltraImageNode; generates from prompt + resolution in one call. [verified: actual release 2024-11-06 (2025-05-06 was ComfyUI integration date), sources: bfl.ai/blog]

models.name: Flux.1 Expand
models.notes: FluxProExpandNode; outpaints the image per prompt. [verified: BFL outpainting endpoint launched 2026-05-14, sources: bfl.ai release notes]

models.name: Flux.1 Fill
models.notes: FluxProFillNode; inpainting from mask + prompt. [verified: FLUX.1 Tools release 2024-11-21, sources: bfl.ai/blog]

models.name: Flux Erase
models.notes: FluxEraseNode; removes masked objects and rebuilds the background. [verified: launched 2026-05-21 (powered by FLUX.2 Klein 9B), sources: bfl.ai release notes]

models.name: Flux Virtual Try-On
models.notes: FluxVTONode; dresses garments onto a person. [verified: launched 2026-05-28; v2 upgrade 2026-07-17 exists, sources: bfl.ai]

notes: BFL is the most complete image partner: dedicated nodes for generation/editing/inpainting/outpainting/erasing/try-on. Legacy Flux2ProImageNode is deprecated; use the DynamicCombo model selection in Flux2ImageNode instead. Integrated 2025-05-06.

models.name: FIBO
models.notes: BriaImageEditNode ('Edit images using Bria latest model'); edits images from natural-language instructions.

models.name: RMBG 2.0
models.notes: BriaRemoveImageBackgroundNode; dedicated matting/background-removal model.

notes: Bria focuses on image editing and background removal; simple nodes, low cost — well suited as a post-processing step for background removal/retouching. Integrated 2026-01-19.

models.name: gemini-2.5-flash-image (Nano Banana)
models.notes: GeminiImageNode 'Nano Banana' for synchronous editing/generation; superseded by Nano Banana 2.

models.name: Nano Banana Pro (gemini-3-pro-image-preview)
models.notes: GeminiImage2Node; Gemini 3 Pro Image preview is still in preview status.

models.name: Nano Banana 2 (Gemini 3.1 Flash Image)
models.notes: GeminiNanoBanana2/V2 nodes; the most capable Gemini image models. The V2 node also supports Nano Banana 2 Lite, 4K output, and thinking control.

models.name: Nano Banana 2 Lite
models.notes: Offered inside GeminiNanoBanana2V2; low-cost, fast tier.

notes: Gemini image path: the old Nano Banana (2.5 flash image) is outdated; the main lineup is now Nano Banana 2 (GeminiNanoBanana2V2 is the newest entry point and supports 4K). The larger file also contains Gemini text/video nodes; only the image category is listed here. Integrated 2025-05-27.

models.name: grok-imagine-image
models.notes: GrokImageNode default tier; basic text-to-image.

models.name: grok-imagine-image-pro
models.notes: Higher-quality tier; max 1 image per call (stricter multi-image limits). [verified: retired 2026-05-15, requests redirect to grok-imagine-image-quality, sources: docs.x.ai]

models.name: grok-imagine-image-quality
models.notes: Maximum-quality tier, most expensive; selectable in both GrokImageNode and GrokImageEditNodeV2. [verified: current top image model (pro redirect target), sources: docs.x.ai]

notes: Grok image capabilities are mature, with three quality tiers; the legacy GrokImageEditNode is deprecated — use GrokImageEditNodeV2 for image editing. Integrated 2026-01-28.

models.name: Ideogram V3
models.notes: IdeogramV3 node; known for strong text/logo rendering. [verified: legacy tier (API V_3_1); Ideogram 4.0 is flagship, sources: docs.ideogram.ai]

models.name: Ideogram 4.0
models.notes: IdeogramV4 node; the latest flagship with further improved quality and text rendering. [verified: current flagship, open-weight, native 2K, transparency, sources: docs.ideogram.ai]

models.name: P-Image
models.notes: IdeogramPImage node; fast, low-cost tier.

notes: Ideogram is the recommended choice for text/logo/poster text-to-image work, with V3/V4/P-Image tiers all available; it was missing from partner_nodes_scan.json (scan omission) and is added here. Integrated 2025-05-06.

models.name: Krea 2 Medium
models.notes: Krea2ImageNode; 1K resolution, supports style_reference and moodboard.

models.name: Krea 2 Medium Turbo
models.notes: Speed-first tier; ~$0.015 per image.

models.name: Krea 2 Large
models.notes: High-quality tier; ~$0.06 per image.

notes: Krea 2 specializes in design-forward images, used with the Krea2StyleReferenceNode style-reference node; creativity (raw/low/medium/high) is configurable. Integrated 2026-05-27.

models.name: photon-1
models.notes: The classic Photon model used by LumaImageGenerationNode/LumaImageModifyNode. [verified: Photon ~Oct 2025, $0.015/1080p; UNI-1 is newer unified editing lineup, sources: docs.lumalabs.ai]

models.name: photon-flash-1
models.notes: Photon fast tier; lower cost.

models.name: uni-1
models.notes: Luma UNI-1 unified image model; up to 9 reference images, aspect ratios 3:1-1:3.

models.name: uni-1-max
models.notes: UNI-1 high-end tier; priced at about 2.5x uni-1.

notes: Luma has two image paths: the legacy Photon nodes (Text to Image / Image to Image, synchronous) and the newer UNI-1 nodes (up to 9 reference images for editing); new workflows should use LumaImageNode/LumaImageEditNode (UNI-1). Integrated 2025-05-06.

models.name: Magnific Upscale (Creative)
models.notes: Prompt-guided creative upscaling; models: automatic/magnific_illusio/magnific_sharpy/magnific_sparkle.

models.name: Magnific Upscale (Precise V2)
models.notes: High-fidelity upscaling with fine control over sharpness/grain/detail; upscaler options: sublime/photo/photo_denoiser.

models.name: Magnific Style Transfer
models.notes: Style transfer from a reference image with adjustable style strength.

models.name: Magnific Relight
models.notes: Relights images; supports transferring lighting from a reference.

models.name: Magnific Skin Enhancer
models.notes: Multi-mode skin processing (beautify_face, etc.).

notes: Magnific is a professional-grade image enhancement suite: upscaling/style transfer/relighting/skin enhancement — ideal for portrait and product-photo finishing. Integrated 2026-01-27.

models.name: DALL·E 2
models.notes: OpenAIDalle2 node; 256/512/1024 resolutions. Outdated model; not recommended for new use.

models.name: DALL·E 3
models.notes: OpenAIDalle3 node; standard/hd + natural/vivid; superseded by the GPT Image family.

models.name: gpt-image-1
models.notes: Available via OpenAIGPTImage1 (legacy, deprecated) or OpenAIGPTImageNodeV2; an older-generation GPT image model — upgrade to gpt-image-2 recommended.

models.name: gpt-image-1.5
models.notes: Intermediate improved generation; selectable in OpenAIGPTImageNodeV2. [verified: labeled 'previous image generation model'; no GPT Image 3 exists, sources: platform.openai.com/docs/models]

models.name: gpt-image-2
models.notes: Default model in OpenAIGPTImageNodeV2; supports custom sizes 1024-3840, opaque backgrounds, and batch output of up to 8 images. Currently OpenAI's main image model.

notes: OpenAI images: DALL·E 2/3 and gpt-image-1 are the legacy path (the old OpenAIGPTImage1 node is deprecated); the main model is gpt-image-2 in OpenAIGPTImageNodeV2 (the 'GPT Image 2' label on legacy nodes is misleading). Integrated 2025-05-06.
OpenRouter only has an LLM text node in ComfyUI (OpenRouterLLMNode) and no image-class models; listed in the index for completeness. Integrated 2026-05-21.

models.name: Recraft V3
models.notes: The V3 node family is the most complete: TextToImage/ImageToImage/Inpainting/TextToVector/Vectorize/Remove&ReplaceBackground/CrispUpscale + custom styles (Style/Color/Controls/CreateStyle).

models.name: recraftv4
models.notes: V4 base tier; superseded by V4.1.

models.name: recraftv4_pro
models.notes: V4 pro tier; starts at 2048x2048.

models.name: recraftv4_1
models.notes: V4.1 standard tier (default for RecraftV4TextToImageNode).

models.name: recraftv4_1_pro
models.notes: V4.1 pro tier.

models.name: recraftv4_1_utility / utility_pro
models.notes: The utility series targets UI/icon generation; pro is the 2048px high-end variant.

models.name: recraftv4_1_vector
models.notes: The vector variants (utility/utility_pro/pro) handle SVG generation — a Recraft-exclusive capability.

notes: Recraft is the strongest partner for vector/SVG generation (supported in both V3 and V4), while also covering raster generation, inpainting, background removal, and upscaling; its style system (Styles/Infinite Style Library/custom styles) is very mature. Integrated 2025-05-06.

models.name: Reve Image Create
models.notes: ReveImageCreateNode; marked is_deprecated=True on 2026-08-06, service sunsetting (8/14) — do not integrate anew.

models.name: Reve Image Edit
models.notes: ReveImageEditNode; deprecated, sunsetting with the service.

models.name: Reve Image Remix
models.notes: ReveImageRemixNode; deprecated.

notes: All Reve nodes were marked deprecated on 2026-08-06 (git commit #15331); official sunset around 8/14. Kept in the index but all marked not_recommended. Integrated 2026-03-11.

models.name: Gen 4 (gen4_image)
models.notes: RunwayTextToImageNode ('Generate an image from a text prompt using Runway's Gen 4 model'); supports reference-image guidance. This is Runway's only remaining image node; the video-side Gen3a was deprecated on 2026-07-23.

notes: Runway has just one image node (Gen 4 text-to-image; the Aleph2/Gen4 video nodes belong to the video category). Integrated early but with limited image capabilities; fine for simple needs. Integrated 2025-05-27.

models.name: Reimagine (Image Enhance)
models.notes: TopazImageEnhanceV2 node uses the Reimagine model, with face_enhancement, creativity (1-9), and grain control; the legacy TopazImageEnhance should be replaced with V2.

models.name: Bloom 2
models.notes: Topaz upscaling model added in ComfyUI partner nodes 2026-08-04; preserves input aspect ratio.

models.name: Wonder 3.5
models.notes: Topaz upscaling model added in ComfyUI partner nodes 2026-08-04; supports upscale factors from 1x to 6x only; preserves input aspect ratio.

notes: Topaz is a professional upscaling/restoration tool; Reimagine is its generative enhancement model. The Legacy node has been replaced by V2 (also missing from scan.json; added here). Integrated 2025-11-20.

models.name: arrow-1.1
models.notes: Default model for QuiverTextToSVGNode and QuiverImageToSVGNode; supports temperature/top_p sampling and up to 4 reference images.

models.name: arrow-1.1-max
models.notes: High-quality tier; ~$0.3575 per call.

models.name: arrow-preview
models.notes: Preview model; actually more expensive ($0.429) — generally not recommended.

notes: Quiver specializes in SVG generation and vectorization — competing with Recraft's vector capabilities but more focused; ImageToSVG supports auto_crop and target_size. Integrated 2026-03-20.

models.name: SeedVR2
models.notes: WavespeedImageUpscaleNode; SeedVR team model (same lineage as the ByteDance Seed ecosystem); default recommended tier.

models.name: Ultimate
models.notes: Extreme-quality tier for final output; target resolutions 2K/4K/8K.

notes: WaveSpeed's image side only has upscaling nodes, focused on 4K/8K enlargement (video side has FlashVSR upscaling); well suited as the final step of an image pipeline. Integrated 2026-01-20.

models.name: Seedream 3.0 (seedream-3-0-t2i-250415)
models.notes: Used by ByteDanceImageNode; the whole node is is_deprecated=True, superseded by Seedream 4/5.

models.name: Seedream 5.0 Pro
models.notes: First choice in ByteDanceSeedreamNodeV2; API id seedream-5-0-pro-260628; up to 14 reference images and 4K support.

models.name: Seedream 5.0 Lite
models.notes: API id seedream-5-0-260128; lightweight tier; supports 14 reference images and 4K.

models.name: Seedream 4.5
models.notes: API id seedream-4-5-251128; mature, stable tier; up to 10 reference images.

models.name: Seedream 4.0
models.notes: API id seedream-4-0-250828; superseded by 4.5/5.0.

models.name: Seedream 5.0 Pro Layer Separation
models.notes: New ByteDanceSeedreamLayerSeparationNode (commit #15317); outputs layered images, to be used with ImageCompositor workflows.

notes: ByteDance/Seedream is one of the strongest Chinese text-to-image + single-sentence editing options today; the legacy ByteDanceImageNode and ByteDanceSeedreamNode (old V3 schema) are both deprecated — use Seedream 5.0 pro/lite via ByteDanceSeedreamNodeV2. Integrated 2025-09-03.

models.name: Qwen Image 3.0
models.notes: Qwen Image 3.0: Alibaba text-to-image and image-editing model.

models.name: Qwen Image 3.0 Pro
models.notes: Qwen Image 3.0 Pro: higher-quality variant of Qwen Image 3.0.

notes: Qwen image models used by QwenImageEditApi / QwenImageTextToImageApi (2026-08).
